title: Sweet Velvety Flaxseed Pancakes
description: Moist and fluffy pancakes made with ground flaxseed and a hint of sour flavor, topped with a velvety sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together ground flaxseed, sour milk, maple syrup, baking powder, and salt.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the mixture by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve with velvety sauce, if desired.
